lines.2: For a moment, I could have sworn her eyes flashed.
lines.5: She called the computer a box.
lines.6: 「Is the computer not over here? The ones at school look like this.」
lines.7: 「That's the monitor. The tower over here is the actual computer. The school uses laptops, right?」
lines.8: 「I-is that so? The box is the computer?」
lines.9: 「...I am not especially knowledgeable in that field.」
lines.10: 「This is a game console. I know that much.」
lines.11: 「Well, they sell it all over the world.」
lines.14: 「I have seen few boys' rooms other than my younger brother's and my grandfather's.」
lines.15: 「You've never dated a guy or anything?」
lines.16: 「I have not. Do you have a complaint?」
lines.17: That was hardly something to say so proudly.
lines.18: Otome inspected every corner of the room.
lines.19: 「Do these drawers hold notebooks and textbooks?」
lines.20: 「Pretty much. You can check if you want.」
lines.22: 「Speaking of textbooks, I am capable enough academically to teach material one year below my level.」
lines.23: 「Take advantage of this opportunity. Ask me about anything you do not understand and improve your studies.」
lines.25: 「Do not hold back. I am your older sister, after all.」
lines.27: Thank goodness I had left my adult books with Fukahire.
lines.28: 「This is quite old. A kendama, is it not?」
lines.29: 「It's actually a hidden talent of mine. I practiced on the sly when I was little.」
lines.30: 「Hmm. Is this what they call a bottle ship?」
lines.33: 「How do I put this? Building bottle ships is my hobby...」
lines.34: 「If somebody carelessly criticizes one, scolds me over it, or touches it, I tend to snap. So be careful.」
lines.35: 「I would not disparage another person's hobby, but I was about to touch it.」
lines.36: 「Understood. I will not touch these from now on.」
lines.38: 「I am glad you have something you can lose yourself in.」
lines.40: 「No, I think everything else is fine.」
lines.41: 「What about you, Otome? Anything I shouldn't touch?」
lines.43: With that, she resumed looking around the room.
lines.44: 「Overall, the room passes inspection for cleanliness.」
lines.45: ...Thank goodness I usually kept it tidy.
lines.46: 「Well, I should be going to bed.」
